title: Smoked Argentinian Pork Chop with Roasted Pak Choi
description: A hearty and savory dish featuring smoked argentinian pork chops paired with roasted pak choi.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Season the pork chops with salt, pepper, and roasted garlic.
Grill the pork chops for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Meanwhile, toss the pak choi with olive oil and a pinch of salt.
Grill the pak choi for 2-3 minutes per side, or until slightly charred.
Transfer the pork chops to a plate and top with grated cheese.
Return the pork chops to the grill for an additional 30 seconds to melt the cheese.
Serve the pork chops with roasted pak choi on the side.
